verdict.rationale: Evidence only shows Datadog exposing its own official MCP server so external agents can call Datadog's tools (datadog-docs-3, datadog-probe-3) — the reverse direction of this story, which asks whether a user can plug external MCP servers into Datadog so Datadog's own AI features (e.g., Bits AI) can consume their tools. No documentation shows Datadog acting as an MCP client or supporting configurable MCP server connections for its own AI assistant.
